title: aifullpeople config
description: Documentation reference for .aifullpeople/config.yaml — not enforced by a script (architecture.md §5: reading/editing a small config is model work, not script work). Read this before hand-editing the file.

human_in_the_loop.description: Requires explicit human approval at every stage transition (architecture.md §15) — separate from the 6+1 quality Gates. Default true; set false only to opt into fully autonomous runs (automation/CI).

language.description: Language of all generated prose content (PRD, design, tasks, reports). IDs, JSON keys, and file names stay ASCII/English regardless (architecture.md §10).

methodology.description: Default methodology for NEW features. Never retroactive — each feature locks its own methodology at creation time in state.json (architecture.md §9). Today only "aifullpeople" exists.

primary_language.description: Selects guidelines/<primary_language>/ (architecture.md §5). Must match a folder that exists under the installed framework's guidelines/.

guidelines_exclude.description: Optional. Names of shared guideline categories to skip loading (e.g. ["naming-conventions"]). Default behavior with this omitted: load all 5 shared root guidelines + everything in guidelines/<primary_language>/.

gates.description: Quality gates (architecture.md §8). compile and tests cannot be disabled — they are the minimum bar for a feature to reach done.

custom.description: Set true only if the project has a Gate 4 custom script (architecture.md §15 open item: exact discovery convention still TBD — document it in context_project.md when configured).

security.description: Proposed 7th gate (govulncheck for Go, etc.) — off by default until confirmed per project.
